results.title: In Nepal, CREC's 13.3-km Sunkoshi Marin Diversion Tunnel channels water from the Sunkoshi River to the water-scarce Marin River basin.
results.description:
In Nepal, CREC's 13.3-km Sunkoshi Marin Diversion Tunnel channels water from the Sunkoshi River to the water-scarce Marin River basin.
Now in operation, it provides irrigation for 122,000 hectares of farmland and generates 28.62 MW of clean hydropower, supporting local agriculture and sustainable development.

results.title: Recent examples include the July 2026 Liulan Reservoir breach in Guangxi after typhoon rains (part of ~159 deaths, investigation ongoing wit
results.description:
Recent examples include the July 2026 Liulan Reservoir breach in Guangxi after typhoon rains (part of ~159 deaths, investigation ongoing with public tips sought) and the Aug 2026 Gyirong Port mudslide (glacial trigger from Nepal side, destroyed BRI border facilities, official China toll ~21-43 dead +500 missing vs higher Nepal figures; reports note info controls). 

No confirmed recent dam failures wiping entire villages at Banqiao scale. Tunnel inrushes and small building collapses have caused deaths (e.g., 7 in 2025 Yunnan rail tunnel). Dam-linked landslides occurred (Hongqi Bridge 2025). Official workplace totals remain the clearest aggregate; natural/infra events are reported case-by-case with noted opacity in sensitive areas.

results.title: "As of September 23, Nepal’s National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority counted 1,453 dead, 5,644 still missing, and 13,795 r
results.description:
"As of September 23, Nepal’s National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority counted 1,453 dead, 5,644 still missing, and 13,795 rescued, with 1,112 people in 21 displacement centers. Earlier reporting put the infrastructure loss at more than 40 bridges, some 25 miles of road, and 15 damaged hydropower plants carrying roughly 753 megawatts, about 11 percent of Nepal’s generating capacity. Nepal mobilized around 19,000 security personnel, and #China deployed some 2,100 rescue workers on its side of the border. The government requested heavy-lift cargo drones from international partners to reach mountain settlements that no longer had roads."

2/3
